notes: Companions (PLAN-COMPANIONS.md): the engine's own content, not from the original game. Edit freely.

talk: answer-menu topics. when: conditions (in_party, party_full, waiting, combat, joined_before, dead_ally, map, present, absent, flag, not_flag, step_done, step_not_done, asked, not_asked, leveling (Leveling active), reagents / not_reagents ("out", "low", "ok": data/companion_magic.json)).
say: lines barked in order; alt: [{when, say}] variants (the first that holds); action: join wait follow leave trade bye picklock steal cast:<spell>; set: flags; topics: a sub-menu.

found_again (a bark, game/party.h): the line of someone back home after dying, when found. leveling: level 1 stats with the Leveling option on, and the class whose gains in level_classes they take; stats stays for Leveling off (a floor of mana can be given, for a spell that must stay castable).

barks: lines by trigger (greet, greet_party, greet_again, join, refuse_full, wait, follow, leave, bye, home, idle, waiting, combat, low_hp, ally_down, kill, revived, theft, innocent, no_mana, cast_ok, cast_nobody, reagents_low, reagents_out, restock, restock_poor, spell_locked, picklock_<result>, steal_<result>); area_barks: on arriving on a map.
spawn: the beach spot (debug mode, and the fallback). home: where they wait to be found: {map, x, y, z, dir, place}; checked by tests/test_homes.cpp and test_route.cpp.
{avatar} in a line is the Avatar's name. art.recolour: hue rules (degrees) for the world shape; paperdoll_recolour: for the paperdoll picture.
spells: kind bolt / lightning / drain / field / knock / slow / calm / summon / heal / cure / raise; type: damage type bits (combat.md: 0x08 fire, 0x10 undead, 0x20 magic, 0x80 pierce = always hits).
Lore checked against the game's texts: Theurgy is the air school (Stratos, the theurgists of Argentrock), Thaumaturgy the ether (Mythran), Tempestry Hydros' power held by the Tempest.

companions.name: Morvain
companions.title: gravekeeper
companions.role: caster: grave magic (drains life, raises a skeleton for a while)

art.note: Malchir's hooded robe (full walk/run/attack/hit/die/cast 27-31); red trim turned moss green

talk.label: name
say: Morvain. My mother named me for the morning mist over the graves. She had a gravedigger's idea of poetry.

talk.label: job
say: I kept the cemetery north of Tenebrae, beside the necromancers. I dug, I washed the dead, I sang them into the earth.
Then a new keeper came and I was not needed. So I mind the old plots he is not paid to. The dead are good listeners.

talk.label: Lithos
say: Lithos is the Titan of Earth, the Mountain King. Long ago our people made a pact with him: still the shaking ground, and we give him our dead.
Every grave in Tenebrae is a promise kept. Break it, and the earth remembers.

topics.label: necromancy
say: Necromancy is not cruelty, whatever the townsfolk whisper. It is the patience of the earth: bone, blood and dirt, and words the ground can hear.
I know a little. Enough to draw strength from the dying and to wake old bones for a short while. Not enough to frighten Vividos.

topics.label: the dead
say: The dead are not gone, only quiet. Lithos keeps them, and they work for him in the dark.
I would not have them disturbed for a handful of rings. If thou robbest a grave while I walk with thee, I will say nothing. But I will remember.

topics.label: gravedigging
say: First rule of gravedigging: make the hole a little longer than the man. They stretch.

talk.label: Titans
say: Four Titans rule this land: Lithos below us, Hydros in the deep, Pyros in the fire mountains, Stratos in the high winds. Each takes its due.
Four Titans rule this land: Lithos below, Hydros in the deep, Pyros in the fire, Stratos in the wind.
Kalvax will tell thee Pyros is the greatest. Fire burns bright. Earth is still here when it goes out.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: A city of the Tempest's people. Mordea rules, the guards bark, the merchants weigh their coin twice. I bury them all the same, in the end.

talk.label: my quest
say: Thou seekest a way home? Then thou must go where the living seldom go. The necromancers under the cemetery know more than they say.
Thou hast stood before the Mountain King himself. I have buried kings. I have never met one who was a mountain.
Thou hast been below, among the old ones of the catacombs. Thou smellest of old dust. Good. They will have marked thee.
Thou hast walked among my old headstones. Did Vividos speak to thee? He speaks to few of the living.

talk.label: Corvin
say: The thief? He has quick hands and a good heart, and he would deny both. Keep him away from the tombs.

talk.label: What do you mean you're out of spells?
say: My spells are bone, blood and grave-earth, {avatar}, not prayers. When the pouch is empty, so am I.
Next time thou goest to Mythran, I will buy at the same time. But I need money on me: put some obsidian in my pack.

talk.label: your reagents
say: Every spell I cast eats a little bone dust and blackmoor. I count my doses; I will tell thee when they run low.
When thou talkest with Mythran I buy what I need from him, if I have obsidian on me. Put coins in my pack if thou wantest me casting.

found_again: I woke in my own old plot, with earth in my mouth and no grave dug. It seems Lithos does not want me yet. Well. Shall we go on?
greet: Thou walkest softly for one so lately drowned. I am Morvain. The dead and I keep this plot.
Ah. The one Devon pulled from his nets. Lithos has not claimed thee yet, it seems.
greet_again: Back again. The earth brings everything back, given time.
greet_party: Speak. I am listening, as the dead listen.
join: Very well. Someone should be on hand to bury thee properly.
I will walk with thee. This plot is quiet, but so is a tomb.
refuse_full: Thou hast company enough. Too many feet trample the graves.
wait: I will wait. Waiting is most of my trade.
leave: Then I stop here. The ground asks no questions.
bye: Until the earth calls one of us.
home: A sandal came up with the frost this morning. Only one. I buried it again, out of habit.
Listen... the ground is murmuring tonight.
The new keeper digs too shallow. I have told him. They stretch.
idle: Mind the soft ground.
There is a grave under every step of this land, if thou digst deep enough.
Lithos is patient. I try to be.
combat: Back to the earth with thee!
low_hp: I am not ready for my own hole yet.
ally_down: Rest now. I will see thee buried properly.
revived: The ground let me go. It does not do that often.
theft: Thou takest what is not thine. The dead see that too.
innocent: That one had done thee no harm. I will dig for them, since thou wilt not.
no_mana: My strength is spent. Let me rest.
reagents_low: My bone dust is running thin. We should stop at Mythran's before long.
reagents_out: That is the last of my grave-earth. No more spells from me until we see Mythran.
restock: Fresh bone and blackmoor. The dead will hear me again.
restock_poor: I have not a coin on me. Put some obsidian in my pack, and next time I will buy.

say: The catacombs. Lower thy voice, they are sleeping.
I know these halls by smell. Do not touch the urns.
My old cemetery. The headstones still lean the way I left them.
The Mountain King's hall. My knees are shaking, and not from the climb.
Earth itself. I can hear it breathing.
Tenebrae. Too many living people in one place.

companions.name: Kalvax
companions.title: exiled sorcerer
companions.role: caster: fire bolts and fire fields

art.note: Vardion's sorcerer coat (cast 27-31); the red coat burned to amber

talk.label: name
say: Kalvax. Remember it. The sorcerers of the Crag will be saying it soon enough, through their teeth.

talk.label: job
say: I was a disciple at Daemon's Crag, until I questioned my master's work in front of his apprentices. Loudly. With flames.
Now I am a sorcerer without a pentagram, at the far edge of my own Crag, where my betters need not look at me. It is very humbling. I hate it.

talk.label: Pyros
say: Pyros, Lord of Flame. The other Titans keep the world. Pyros changes it. Fire takes, and gives back ash, and new things grow from ash.
The sorcerers call daemons in his name and drink a little of his power. A little. I want more than a little.

topics.label: sorcery
say: Sorcery is ritual: a pentagram, the right candles, reagents laid just so, and the will to command whatever answers.
Out here I make do with smaller fires. A bolt, a burning field. Enough to make a troll think twice.

topics.label: power
say: Power is the only honest thing on this isle. The Titans have it, so they are worshipped. I intend to have some.
Do not frown at me. Thou hast more power than any man here, and thou art spending it on going home. What a waste.

talk.label: Titans
say: Lithos sulks under the ground, Hydros drowns whoever she likes, Stratos hides above the clouds. Only Pyros is honest. He burns.
Lithos sulks under the ground, Hydros drowns whoever she likes, Stratos hides in the clouds. Only Pyros is honest.
Morvain disagrees, I am sure. Morvain disagrees with everything that is not already dead.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: A wet little city that bows to a wet little queen. The Tempest holds a sliver of Hydros' power and thinks herself a goddess.

talk.label: my quest
say: Thou wantest to leave this world? Odd. I want to rule a piece of it. Perhaps we can help each other on the way.
The Tongue of Flame. Thou carriest a piece of Pyros himself. Do not look at me like that. I am only admiring it.
Thou hast taken a mentor at the Crag! Bane or Vardion, it matters not. Both will try to use thee. Use them first.

talk.label: Ilvaran
say: The pilgrim? He prays to gods who left. I pray to one who is still burning. We do not agree on much.

talk.label: join me
say: Travel with that ghost-worshipper? He would spend every night praying for my soul.
No. Choose, stranger: him or me.

talk.label: he means no harm
say: Hmph. He did mend that fisherman's hand without asking a coin for it. Fine.
But if he prays at me, I set his robe alight. A small fire. Mostly.

talk.label: What do you mean you're out of spells?
say: Fire needs fuel, {avatar}. Ash, pumice, pig iron. I have none left, so I have no fire.
Next time thou goest to Mythran, I will buy at the same time. But I need money on me. Obsidian, in my pack. I am not a beggar.

talk.label: your reagents
say: Each bolt burns a measure of reagents. I keep count. Thou wilt hear about it when I run low.
Mythran sells them. When thou visitest him, I buy my own, with my own obsidian. So see that I have some.

found_again: Dead? Me? The ash spat me back out on this bluff, and I remember none of it. Whoever did that owes me blood. Lead on, then.
greet: Thou! Yes, thou, the stranger. Thou hast the look of someone with ambition. Or a fever.
Kalvax, sorcerer of Pyros. Exiled, for now. Thou mayest bow.
greet_again: Back to ask for my help? Wise.
greet_party: Speak quickly. Fire does not wait.
join: At last, someone with sense. Lead on, and stand back when I cast.
refuse_full: Thy little band is full. Dismiss someone dull and ask me again.
wait: Wait? Kalvax does not wait. ...Very well. Briefly.
leave: Thy loss. I will be right here, being magnificent.
bye: Do not take long. I grow bored.
home: Ash. Hot ash. Everywhere. I used to love this place.
Look at that lava. Imagine it in the Tempest's harbour.
Disciples. They smell of candle wax. Why must they smell of candle wax?
idle: Is there nothing to burn around here?
My talents are wasted on walking.
Ha! Didst thou see that bird? Neither did I. Boredom makes me see things.
waiting: I am counting cracks in the ground. Hurry.
ally_down: They fell! Someone will pay for that in fire.
theft: Ha! Take it all. The world belongs to the bold.
innocent: Hm. Even I choose my fires better than that.
no_mana: My fire is out. Give me a moment!
reagents_low: My ash pouch is getting light. A visit to Mythran would not go amiss.
reagents_out: Out. Not a pinch of brimstone left. Find me a reagent shop, or find me a sword.
restock: Pumice, ash, pig iron. Now I am dangerous again.
restock_poor: He wants coin and I have none. Thou couldst have mentioned that. Some obsidian in my pack, next time.

say: The Crag. My old masters are here. Let them see me now.
Smell that: sulphur and ambition. Home.
Malchir's fortress. Walk softly and burn loudly.
The heart of Pyros! I could weep. The tears would boil.
Lava! At last, a road with some warmth to it.
Water. Far too much water.

companions.name: Brannoc
companions.title: sellsword
companions.role: fighter: fast, high DEX, a two-handed axe, the best runner

art.note: Darion's plate armour (walk/run/attack with a hit frame/hit/die; Korick 431's attack never reaches); the plate tinted storm blue, the leather dark

talk.label: name
say: Brannoc. On the plateau they say it means raven. They say a lot of things on the plateau.

talk.label: job
say: I watched the storms from the high plateau. Read the clouds, rang the bell when Stratos was angry.
The bell cracked, the pay stopped, and I found I liked swinging an axe better than swinging a bell rope.

talk.label: Stratos
say: Stratos is the air. She breathes, and the grass bows. Giver of Life, the theurgists call her. I just call her weather.
Out on the plateau thou learnest to hear her coming. A hush first, then the grass lies flat, then she arrives.

topics.label: theurgy
say: The theurgists on Argentrock talk to Stratos with their foci and their tests. I never had the patience. I have an axe.

topics.label: the weather
say: Rain by evening. Maybe sooner. My knee says so, and my knee has never lied to me.

talk.label: Titans
say: Four of them, older than anything. They quarrel, and we get quakes and floods and fire. Best stay out of their way.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: Walls. Guards. Rules. I can't breathe in there. The wind can't get in.

talk.label: my quest
say: Thou wantest out of this world? I understand that. I only want out of this valley.
Thou hast stood before Stratos herself, and thou art still standing. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone.
Thou hast been to Argentrock. Did the wind there talk to thee? It talks to everyone. They just don't listen.

talk.label: fighting
say: Two hands, one axe, no tricks. Hit first, hit hard and keep moving. The wind never stands still. Neither should thou.

talk.label: why follow me?
say: Thou payest in trouble, not coin. That's all right. Trouble is honest.

found_again: Woke up here with the wind in my face. Don't know how I got back. Thought thou hadst gone on without me. Good to swing beside thee again.
greet: Wind's turning. Thou art the drowned man? Brannoc. I sell my axe.
Brannoc. Stormwatcher once, sellsword now. What dost thou want?
greet_again: Thou again. Good. I was getting restless.
join: I'm with thee. Don't make me regret it.
refuse_full: Too many already. Crowds make me twitchy.
wait: Fine. I'll stand here and watch the clouds.
leave: Suit thyself. I'll be about here if thou needest an axe.
home: Storm coming in from the west. Always is.
Good ground for running, this. Nobody to run with.
The plateau's just up there. The wind comes off it cold and clean.
idle: Wind's shifting.
Smell that? Rain.
My legs want to run. Let's go faster.
theft: Huh. Didn't see that. Didn't see anything.
innocent: That wasn't a fight. That was butchery.

say: The plateau! Feel that wind!
Home. Or near enough.
Argentrock. Up here even the stones hum.
The sky itself. I could fly, if I had the nerve.
Good open ground. Good running ground.

companions.name: Varn of the Tide
companions.title: warden of Hydros
companions.role: magic warrior: strong melee, healing waters, a slowing tide, a wave that knocks foes back

art.note: the Tempest's guard in armour (walk/run/attack/hit/die, cast 27-29); the blue tabard turned sea green

talk.label: name
say: Varn. Varn of the Tide, they call me, for the oath I swore at the water's edge.

talk.label: job
say: I am a warden of Hydros, one of the last. We guarded the springs and the temple shores long before the Tempest built her palace.
Now the wardens are scattered, and I keep my oath alone.

talk.label: Hydros
say: Hydros. The townsfolk call her the Lurker and fear her. She is the deep water, cold and patient and older than grief.
She takes much. She has also fed this land for a thousand years. Both are true.

topics.label: Tempestry
say: Tempestry is Hydros' gift: to call water, to heal with it, to turn it on a foe. Mordea the Tempest holds most of it now.
The wardens kept a few pieces of the old rite. Enough to mend a wound or slow an enemy. Not enough to stop the rains.

topics.label: the Tempest
say: Mordea holds a portion of Hydros' power and wields it like a sceptre. A warden serves the water, not the throne.
Thou hast proclaimed Devon the rightful heir. The water has a true Tempest again. I owe thee more than I can say.

talk.label: Titans
say: The Titans were meant to keep the world. Instead they quarrel, and the land pays for it: quakes, floods, fire. I mourn what they have done.
Still I keep my oath. An oath kept to a flawed god is still an oath kept.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: The city of the Tempest. Its people are not wicked, only frightened. Fear makes cruel laws.

talk.label: my quest
say: Thou seekest a way out of this world. I will not stand in thy way. But do not leave Pagan worse than thou found it.
Thou hast set Hydros free. The springs run strong again. I felt it here, like a breath held far too long.

talk.label: honour
say: A warden does not lie, does not steal, and does not strike a man who has yielded. I ask the same of those I walk with.
A warden does not lie, does not steal, and does not strike a man who has yielded.
I ask the same of those I walk with. I am looking at thee, Corvin.

found_again: The waters carried me back to this shore; I know not how. I feared I had failed thee, and my oath. I am glad to stand with thee again.
greet: Peace upon thee, stranger from the sea. Hydros spared thee. I would know why.
I am Varn, warden of the Tide. Speak, and be truthful.
greet_again: The tide returns, and so dost thou.
join: I will stand with thee, as I stood at the water's edge.
By the Tide, I am thy shield.
refuse_full: Thy company is large enough. Too many swords and nobody guards the rear.
leave: Go with the current, then. I keep my watch here.
home: Hear the water in the stone? Every drop is a word, if thou art patient.
The lake is restless tonight. Hydros dreams badly.
I wash my blade at the lake's edge each dawn. An old warden's habit.
idle: Keep near the water when thou canst. It remembers its friends.
I pray as we walk. Pay it no mind.
The rains have been heavy. Too heavy.
low_hp: I must fall back. Only a little.
ally_down: A companion has fallen! Guard them!
Rest, friend. The water will carry thee.
revived: I felt the cold water close over me. And then light.
theft: That is theft. I saw it. Do not do it again.
innocent: That was no enemy. Thou hast stained us both.
no_mana: The water in me is spent.
spell_locked: The tide will not answer that call from me yet. Give me time.

say: The deep itself. Speak softly. She is listening.
Carthax Lake, where the waters begin. I have kept watch here longer than I can say.
The Tempest's towers loom over us. Keep thy head down.
The reef. Good fishing, bad currents.

companions.name: Ilvaran
companions.title: Zealan pilgrim
companions.role: caster and healer: heals, cleanses, a light that sears the undead, raises a fallen companion

art.note: Stellos' theurgist robe (cast 27-31); the blue robe turned to Zealan gold

talk.label: name
say: Ilvaran. In the old Zealan tongue it meant one who listens. I try to deserve it.

talk.label: job
say: I am a pilgrim. I walk the roads the Zealans walked, I pray at their broken shrines, and I heal whoever I meet on the way.
The theurgists of Argentrock taught me what little magic I have. The rest is only listening.

talk.label: the Zealans
say: Long ago the Zealans lived here. They honoured the Titans and the Ancient Ones both, and their shrines still stand in the wild places.
Then they were gone. Destroyed or departed, the books do not agree. I hope departed. I like to think they are listening still.

topics.label: Ancient Ones
say: The Ancient Ones were the Zealans' gods, older than the Titans' quarrels. Their shrine lies hidden in the hills. Few go there now.
Thou hast laid the shield on the Zealan altar. I felt it, like a bell rung very far away. Thank thee.

topics.label: theurgy
say: Theurgy is the magic of Stratos, the air. The theurgists carve each spell into a focus and test the heart of whoever would carry it.
My foci are few and worn: healing, cleansing, a little light against the dark. And once in a long while, calling back a soul that has not gone far.

topics.label: raising the dead
say: If a companion falls, bring me to the body soon, before the spirit wanders. It costs me dearly, but I can call them back.
If I fall myself, Nerissa knows a rite of the tide that can call me back. Ask her.

talk.label: Titans
say: Stratos gives breath, Hydros water, Lithos holds the ground and Pyros gives warmth. When they forget their purpose, people suffer. I pray they remember.
Stratos gives breath, Hydros water, Lithos holds the ground and Pyros gives warmth. I pray they remember their purpose.
Kalvax thinks me a fool for praying. Perhaps I am. I pray for him too.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: Tenebrae has forgotten its old prayers. It has guards instead. Perhaps it needs both.

talk.label: a sign?
say: Thou camest out of the sea with a name this land does not know. In the Zealan books, such strangers come when a world is about to change.
Whether that is a blessing or a warning, I cannot tell. Let us find out together.

talk.label: my quest
say: Thou seekest thy way home. I will help thee look. Home is a holy thing.
Thou walkest between the planes now. Be careful there. Even prayers echo strangely.
Thou hast walked on Argentrock, where I made my foci. Did the monks test thee with riddles? They do love their riddles.

found_again: I remember a great stillness, and then these stones. Perhaps the Ancient Ones are not done with me. It is good to see thee, friend.
greet: Be welcome, child of another sky. I am Ilvaran. I have been waiting for thee, I think.
Thou art the one from the sea. A stranger was foretold. Or perhaps it was only the wind.
greet_again: Thou hast returned. That is a good sign.
join: I will walk with thee. May the Ancient Ones light our road.
Gladly. Every road is a pilgrimage, if it is walked rightly.
refuse_full: Thou hast many friends already. Come back for me when the road is less crowded.
leave: Go in peace. I will be here, listening to the wind.
home: The wind in these stones sounds like breathing. Stratos, talking to herself.
A gull landed on my hand this morning. I took it for a blessing.
There is a Zealan glyph scratched on a stone here. The wind has nearly worn it away.
idle: Breathe slowly. The air is a gift.
Every step we take, someone once took before us.
I sense something old nearby.
waiting: I am here, and I am praying.
ally_down: Hold on! Do not go far. I will call thee back!
No! Bring me to them, quickly!
revived: I saw a light. And then thy face. Thank thee.
theft: Oh, my friend. That was not thine to take.
innocent: Why? They meant us no harm. I will pray for them.
no_mana: My foci are dim. I must rest before I can heal again.
cast_ok: There. The air mends what it can.
cast_nobody: No one here needs my help just now. A good thing.
spell_locked: I know the shape of that prayer, but not its words. Learn it thyself first, and I will follow.

say: The shrine of the Ancient Ones. Kneel with me a moment.
Argentrock. I learned my foci on this stone.
Stratos' own plane. Every breath here is a prayer.
The ether. So close to the Ancient Ones...

companions.name: Corvin
companions.title: the Crow
companions.role: rogue: sword fighter, picks locks, steals from NPCs

art.note: Orlok's dockside coat (walk/run/attack/hit/die); the blue coat dyed crow black-green, the vest rust; its attack animation has no hit frame, so the companion AI resolves his blows (half way through the swing when adjacent)

talk.label: name
say: Corvin. The Crow, on the docks. I pick up anything shiny. Don't take it personally.

talk.label: job
say: Trader in other people's belongings. Locks, purses, the occasional window.
The guards and I have an understanding. They chase me, I run. Keeps us both fit.

talk.label: thy skills
say: Locks and pockets. Ask me about either. Or don't, and just watch.

topics.label: locks
say: Every lock is a puzzle some smith was too proud to finish. Show me a locked door and I'll show thee the inside.
Lockpicks? Picks are for amateurs. A bent nail and a steady hand.

topics.label: stealing
say: I don't rob the poor. They've nothing worth having. I rob the rich, and guards, who are rich in the evenings.
If I'm seen, mind, the whole street comes running. So pick thy moments. And pick mine.

talk.label: the docks
say: The docks are where Tenebrae keeps its secrets: smugglers, fishermen and the headsman's block. Lovely spot for an execution. Terrible for a picnic.

talk.label: Titans
say: Titans? Big, angry, invisible. I give them the same respect I give the tax collector. I avoid them.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: Best city in the world for a man of my talents. Lots of locks, lots of guards with short legs.
Devon on the throne! I knew him when he was gutting fish. Now I'll have to rob him respectfully.

talk.label: my quest
say: A way home, eh? If there's a door between worlds, somebody has locked it. Lucky thou met me.
Thou hast met Mythran. Did he try to sell thee something? He sold me a lucky ring once. Not lucky.

talk.label: art thou honest?
say: Honest? Me? I'm wounded. ...Look. I've never robbed a widow and never left a friend behind. That's more than most honest men can say.
Don't spread it about. It would ruin my reputation.

talk.label: Varn
say: The warden glares at me as if I'd lifted his sword. I haven't. Yet.

found_again: Don't ask me. One moment I'm dying, the next I'm on these rocks with all my teeth. Best trick I ever pulled, and I wish I knew how I did it.
greet: Well, if it isn't the drowned rat himself. Corvin. Friends call me the Crow. Enemies call the guards.
Shh. Pretend thou didst not see me. ...Too late? Corvin, at thy service. For a fee.
greet_again: Back for more of my charm? That's free. Everything else costs.
join: Partners, then. I take a fair share. That is, most of it.
Lead the way, boss. I'll watch thy back. And thy purse.
refuse_full: Full house. Three's company, seven's a parade.
leave: No hard feelings. I'll be about, admiring other people's boots.
bye: See thee around. Or not, if I'm doing it right.
home: A smuggler's boat came in last night. I know nothing. Nothing at all.
Sand gets into locks and ruins them. Good for business, really.
Psst. Nice boots.
idle: That merchant's purse was practically waving at me.
Keep thy voice down. We're being clever.
I know a shortcut. Never mind, it involves a window.
combat: Ooh, that one's got a purse.
ally_down: Oi! Who's going to carry the loot now?
No, no, no. Get up, friend.
kill: Mine! The kill, I mean. And whatever's in his pockets.
revived: Was I dead? Did anyone go through my pockets?
theft: Hah! A natural. I'm almost proud.
innocent: Hey. That wasn't a job, that was murder. I don't do murder.
picklock_not_locked: It isn't locked. Even I can't unlock an open door.
picklock_not_a_lock: That's not a lock, boss. That's a... thing.
picklock_too_far: Get me closer to it. I can't pick it from here.
steal_stolen: Got it. Quiet as a crow.
Lighter purse for them, heavier for us.
steal_stolen_seen: Got it, but they saw! Walk. Don't run. Run!
steal_too_far: I need to be close enough to brush past them.
steal_dead: The dead keep their pockets. Morvain would never forgive me.

say: Ah, the docks. Smell that? Fish and opportunity.
Tenebrae. Hood up, eyes down, hands busy.
The Obsidian Fortress. So many shiny things. So many sorcerers.
Treasure Cove? Why did nobody tell me about this place?

companions.name: Wynna
companions.title: thaumaturge
companions.role: caster: lightning and a gust that knocks foes down

art.note: Mordea's gown (cast 27-29); the white dress tinted lavender

talk.label: name
say: Wynna. Just Wynna. Mythran called me 'that girl' for three years, so Wynna is a step up.

talk.label: job
say: I studied with Mythran on the plateau. Thaumaturgy, the magic of the ether, the stuff between everything!
He said I asked too many questions. I said that was the point of studying. He disagreed. Loudly. So here I am!

talk.label: thaumaturgy
say: The other schools beg a Titan for scraps. Thaumaturgy goes round them, straight to the ether: the fifth thing, the glue of the world.
Reagents, gestures, a bit of nerve. I can throw lightning, knock a man flat with a gust of nothing, and once I made Mythran's beard float. He did not laugh.

topics.label: Mythran
say: Mythran is brilliant and grumpy and sells his spells far too dear. Don't tell him I said brilliant.
Thou hast met him! Did he mention me? He didn't, did he. Typical.

topics.label: danger
say: Danger is only excitement with bad manners. Ha! Thou shouldst see thy face.

talk.label: thy world
say: Tell me about thy world! Is there magic there? Titans? Do people really sail between the stars? I'd give my last reagent to see it.
Promise thou wilt describe everything. Every detail. Especially the food.

talk.label: Titans
say: Four Titans, four elements, and then the ether, which belongs to nobody. That's why I like it.
Four Titans, four elements, and the ether, which belongs to nobody. That's why I like it.
Please don't let Kalvax start on Pyros again. I'm begging thee.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: Tenebrae has a library! A small, damp, guarded library. I may have borrowed a book. Permanently.

talk.label: my quest
say: A gate home! Between worlds! Oh, I want to see that. Take me when thou findest it. I'll only look, I promise.
Thou hast walked in the ether itself! Is it blue? I always imagined it blue.
Ethereal Travel! Thou hast it! Teach me. No? Not even a little? Just the hand movements?

talk.label: What do you mean you're out of spells?
say: Thaumaturgy needs reagents! Eye of newt, bat wing, serpent scale, dragon blood. And I've used them all up. Sorry!
Next time thou goest to Mythran, I'll buy at the same time. But I need money on me! Drop some obsidian in my pack, please?

talk.label: your reagents
say: Every spell uses a pinch of something. I count! I'll tell thee when I'm running low.
Mythran sells all of them. When thou talkest with him I'll buy more, if I have obsidian on me. His prices are terrible, though.

found_again: Oh! There thou art! I don't know what happened, I just opened my eyes here, soaking wet! Isn't that strange? I thought thou hadst left me!
greet: Oh! Thou art the one from the sea! Is it true thou comest from another world? What's it like? Do the stars move? Sorry. Wynna. Hello!
Wynna! Thaumaturge. Well, nearly. Mostly. Hello!
greet_again: Thou art back! I have twelve new questions.
join: Yes! Yes, yes. Oh, this will be wonderful. Where are we going?
An adventure, with a man from another world! Mythran will be so jealous.
refuse_full: Oh, thou hast so many friends already. Make room for me later?
wait: I'll wait! I'll study the clouds. Or the moss. Moss is interesting, didst thou know?
leave: Oh. Oh, all right. Come back and tell me everything!
home: If the ether is in everything, is it in the pond? Is the pond thinking?
I counted the mushrooms. Eleven hundred and four. Then I lost count.
Hello again, toad.
idle: What's that? Oh, just a rock. A very interesting rock.
Does thy world have beaches? Are they this cold?
My fingertips are prickling. Can we fight something?
ally_down: Get up, get up, please get up!
kill: Didst thou see that? Didst thou SEE that?
revived: I was dead! What was it like? I can't remember. How annoying!
innocent: Why did thou do that? That was... horrible.
no_mana: Reagents spent, head empty. Give me a moment!
reagents_low: Oh! I'm nearly out of newt eyes. Can we go and see Mythran soon? Please?
reagents_out: That was my last bat wing. I'm out! Completely out! We need Mythran.
restock: Dragon blood! Real dragon blood! Oh, I'll be careful with it. Mostly.
restock_poor: I couldn't buy anything, I've no money! Put some obsidian in my pack and I'll buy next time.

say: The plateau. Mythran's tower is near. Hide me.
The ether! Look at it! LOOK at it!
Argentrock. So many riddles, so little time.

companions.name: Nerissa
companions.title: tide-seer
companions.role: caster: tide's mending, ice shards, calming a foe; the rite that calls Ilvaran back

art.note: her own figure (data/shapes/nerissa.shp, painted over the Avatar's frames by pagan_skin): long dark hair, a sea-foam dress to mid-calf with a pale sash and deep-blue hem, bare arms, blue slippers; the paperdoll shows the same figure

paperdoll_recolour.note: her figure's hair below the painted head, as dark as the portrait's

fallback.note: Cyrrus' white robe, white and blue turned sea-foam green (only if data/shapes/ is not found)

talk.label: name
say: Nerissa. A fisherman's daughter, once. Now the fishermen leave me bread and do not meet my eyes.

talk.label: job
say: I hear Hydros in the waves. Not words, not quite. Moods. Warnings. What is coming.
They call it Tempestry, the little I have. Mordea has the throne. I have the shore.

talk.label: Hydros
say: She is not cruel, only deep. Everything that falls into the sea, she keeps. Sometimes she gives something back.
She gave thee back. Remember that.

topics.label: what dost thou see?
say: I see thee walking into fire, and out again. I see a gate of black stone. I see thee alone at the end.
Do not look so grave. The sea is often wrong about endings.

topics.label: the rite of the tide
say: There is an old rite: sea water, a name spoken into it, and a soul not yet gone far comes back along the current.
It is meant for one who heals others. If Ilvaran falls, I can call him back that way. Only him. The tide knows his name.

talk.label: Titans
say: The Titans are tired, I think. Old and tired, and angry because they are tired. Hydros dreams of rest.

talk.label: Tenebrae
say: When the rains come too hard, Tenebrae floods at the docks first. The poor drown first. The sea told me so.

talk.label: Devon
say: Devon is kind. He cut thee free of his nets. The sea favours him more than he knows.
So thou knowest now what Devon is. The sea knew all along. She sang it to me as a lullaby.

talk.label: my quest
say: Thou wilt leave this world. I have seen it. But not soon.
Hydros is free. The waves sound glad, for the first time in my life.

found_again: I don't know what happened. The tide laid me on this shore, the way it lays down shells. I thought thou hadst left me. I am glad thou didst not.
greet: The sea said thou wouldst come today. It did not say thou wouldst be so tall.
I am Nerissa. I listen to the tide. Sit a while, if thou wish.
greet_again: Thou hast come back. The tide said thou might.
join: I will come. The tide says I must.
Yes. I have seen us walking together. It is better than the other way.
refuse_full: Thou art not alone enough to need me now.
wait: I will wait by the water's voice.
leave: The sea will keep me. Go well.
bye: Listen to the water when thou canst.
home: Shh. She is singing.
The foam is pink at the edges tonight. Someone drowned far out.
The gulls know when a storm is coming. So do I.
idle: Rain soon.
The water under the ground is moving. Canst thou feel it?
Hydros dreams of thee sometimes.
low_hp: The current is pulling me under...
ally_down: No... I did not see this. Why did I not see this?
Hold on to the current. Hold on.
revived: The water carried me back. It is cold, coming back.
theft: The sea sees what thou hast taken. So do I.
innocent: The sea will remember that one.
no_mana: The tide in me is low. Give it time to come in.
cast_ok: Let the cold water close the wound.
There. Salt and water, as it always was.
cast_nobody: No one needs the water's care just now.
spell_locked: The sea is not ready to give me that yet.

say: Her home. Do not be afraid. She knows us.
Carthax. Where all the waters begin.
The reef. My father fished here.
